// diagnostic

E0924

A method is read without parentheses where it is no function value

What

A method is read without parentheses where it is no function value

Why

A method read without parentheses is a function value only where a function type is expected, and only while its receiver is kept: a `&self` method's changes must reach the receiver, and a `&&self` method never binds. Anywhere else the read is a forgotten call.

Fix

Call the method, or write a closure that calls it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0924: Tests/UI/bound_method_union_suggests_call.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidUnionMember]: `fn() -> Int` can't be a union member
  --> Tests/UI/bound_method_union_suggests_call.jet:10:17
    |
 10 | show: fn(value: Int | fn() -> Int) { print("shown") }
    |                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Anonymous unions hold concrete closed types — not type parameters, trait objects, or function types
 Fix: Use a named enum when a member needs an open shape
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0363

Error [jet.MethodReadWithoutCall]: `total` is a method of `Crew`, not a field; call it: `.total()`
  --> Tests/UI/bound_method_union_suggests_call.jet:14:15
    |
 14 |     show(crew.total)
    |               ^^^^^
 Why: A method read without parentheses is a value only where a function type is expected; anywhere else it is a forgotten call
 Fix: Add `()` to call `total`, or write a closure that calls it
